title: WelcomePlus-mc
description: A modern Paper plugin that welcomes players with titles, items, and messages.
body:
WelcomePlus is a modern Paper plugin that enhances player joins with clean titles,
configurable messages, and first-join rewards.

✨ Features
• Join Title & Subtitle (MiniMessage supported)
• First-join items
• Configurable timings
• Reload command
• Paper-safe (no deprecated APIs)
• Supports 1.20 – 1.21.8

🛠 Commands
/welcomeplus reload – Reload configuration
/welcomeplus test – Test the join title

📦 Requirements
• Paper or Purpur
• Java 21

🧩 Configuration
All messages, timings, and features are configurable via config.yml.

💙 Free & open for community use.
